description: Defines the enumeration ChargeTimeType representing various charge timing categories in the Apache Fineract project. Includes methods for retrieving charge types based on integer values, checking charge type properties, and validating charge types for different financial products.

classes.name: ChargeTimeType
classes.description: Enumeration representing different scheduled charge times, with attributes, utility methods, and category checks.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with this charge time type.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code string associated with this charge time type.

methods.name: validLoanValues
methods.description: Provides an array of integer values valid for loan charges.

methods.name: validLoanChargeValues
methods.description: Provides an array of integer values valid for loan-specific charges.

methods.name: validSavingsValues
methods.description: Provides an array of integer values valid for savings charges.

methods.name: validClientValues
methods.description: Provides an array of integer values valid for client charges.

methods.name: validShareValues
methods.description: Provides an array of integer values valid for share account charges.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to its corresponding ChargeTimeType enum, or INVALID if no match.

methods.name: isTimeOfDisbursement
methods.description: Checks if this charge type is for disbursement time.

methods.name: isOnSpecifiedDueDate
methods.description: Checks if this charge type is based on a specified due date.

methods.name: isSavingsActivation
methods.description: Checks if this charge type is for savings account activation.

methods.name: isSavingsClosure
methods.description: Checks if this charge type is for savings account closure.

methods.name: isWithdrawalFee
methods.description: Checks if this charge type is a withdrawal fee.

methods.name: isSavingsNoActivityFee
methods.description: Checks if this charge type is for savings account no activity fee.

methods.name: isAnnualFee
methods.description: Checks if this charge type is an annual fee.

methods.name: isMonthlyFee
methods.description: Checks if this charge type is a monthly fee.

methods.name: isWeeklyFee
methods.description: Checks if this charge type is a weekly fee.

methods.name: isInstalmentFee
methods.description: Checks if this charge type is an installment fee.

methods.name: isSpecifiedDueDate
methods.description: Checks if this charge type is for specified due date.

methods.name: isOverdueInstallment
methods.description: Checks if this charge type is for overdue installment.

methods.name: isAllowedLoanChargeTime
methods.description: Determines if this charge type is allowed during loan charge periods.

methods.name: isAllowedClientChargeTime
methods.description: Determines if this charge type is allowed during client charge periods.

methods.name: isAllowedSavingsChargeTime
methods.description: Determines if this charge type is allowed during savings charge periods.

methods.name: isOverdraftFee
methods.description: Checks if this charge type is an overdraft fee.

methods.name: isTrancheDisbursement
methods.description: Checks if this charge type is tranche disbursement.

methods.name: isShareAccountActivation
methods.description: Checks if this charge type is for share account activation.

methods.name: isSharesPurchase
methods.description: Checks if this charge type is for share purchase.

methods.name: isSharesRedeem
methods.description: Checks if this charge type is for share redemption.
